items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: George Hartman, he was out there in the lake for a long time playing for the Thorngarals and all that.

ctx.x: I got some acetates by that band. Yeah. They all moved to it though.
That fellow, who was the fellow? George Hartman, he was out there in the lake for a long time playing for the Thorngarals and all that.
This was at the Thorngarals. Frank Clark played a pretty good piano. Yeah, and this kid here was AJ Salaci. That was the last time I used him once and I was seeing old Gene and Bazley on the drum.
